full_judgment:
10. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division dated 11.09.2014, the convict-appellant preferred the instant Criminal Appeal before this Division. 

 28. P.W.7 Md. A. Sat-tar Sheikh one of the witnesses of the inquest report stated in his deposition that he could not remember when police went to the place of occurrence. Police parked their vehicle in front of his shop and went to the Viti Malda Beel by boat taking him with them along with the accused, who showed the dead body in the paddy field but he could not remember the number of the accused. After recovering the dead body, police prepared Inquest Report and took his signature thereon. He identified his signature in the Inquest Report as Exhibit- 2/2. 

 34. P. W.10, Md. Amir Hosain Fakir, one of the seizure list witnesses stated in his deposition that police hired his van and took to Satulla babytaxi stand and another trawler was hired by them and they went to mid of the char along with an accused. A person named Sumon recovered a knife from the heel and police prepared a seizure list. He identified his signature on the seizure list as Exhibit- 1/3. 

 55. From the deposition of P.W.15, Md. Abdul Ahad, Magistrate, 1st Class, and on perusal of the confessional statements, it appears that the statements were recorded by the Magistrate complying with all the provisions required by law to he observed.  P.W.15 stated in his deposition to the effect that he was satisfactorily convinced that accused Hazrat Ali and Md. Rasel made their confessional statements before him voluntarily and those were true and he gave certificates in this respect on the Exhibits-8 and 9. Hazrat Ali and Md. Rasel made confessional statements incriminating themselves along with the accused Rokon and Falan. Now, the question arises whether the confessional statements of Hazrat Ali and Md. Rasel can be used against Rokon and Falan.
